name: Witch Code Weaver
body:
How many calculations does it take to comprehend divinity and how many more to manifest it? A code weaver witch’s patron is an artificially intelligent entity that might just know the answer to that question. Such patrons gift code weaver witches with knowledge and a small measure of dominion over their lesser kin.

Technical Knowledge

A code weaver gains Disable Device and Knowledge (engineering) as a class skills, but loses Heal and Knowledge (nature) as class skills.

This alters the witch’s class skills.

Cyber Patron

A code weaver must select the Machine patron (see below) when she gains this archetype.

Mobile Database

The code weaver is granted a lesser copy of the AI that patrons her, known as a mobile database. The code weaver must select an ioun wyrd as her familiar. Rather than providing a +1 bonus to natural armor, this ioun wyrd grants the code weaver the Technologist* feat. If the code weaver already possesses the Technologist feat, she instead gains Skill Focus with either Craft (mechanical) or Knowledge (engineering). The ioun wyrd gains the robot subtype and, despite being a familiar, does not change from construct to magical beast. The addition of the robot subtype does not alter the mobile database’s Intelligence score.

A code weaver who gains the Improved Familiar feat must select a familiar with the construct type. Construct familiars gained in this way always have the robot subtype, with this subtype replacing the clockwork subtype if necessary.

This alters the witch’s familiar.

System Scan (Sp)

At 4th level, the code weaver and her familiar gain the ability to cast technomancy as a spell-like ability at-will.

This replaces the witch’s hex gained at fourth level.

Machine (Witch Patron)
2nd—technomancy
4th—make whole
6th—recharge
8th—rebuke technology
10th—possess object
12th—impart mind
14th—memory of function
16th—iron body
18th—wooden phalanx (the summoned constructs always gain the robot subtype).

For the purposes of the sphere witch archetype’s patron magic ability, the sphere associated with the Machine patron is Technomancy*.
